---
title: "Get Started"
---

Get up and running with *animovement* in three steps.

## [1]{.step-number} Install

*animovement* is distributed through [r-universe](https://animovement.r-universe.dev).
Install the metapackage — and the whole ecosystem — with:

```r
install.packages(
  "animovement",
  repos = c(
    "https://animovement.r-universe.dev",
    "https://cloud.r-project.org"
  )
)
```

::: {.callout-tip}
## Only need one piece?
Every package installs the same way — swap `"animovement"` for the individual
package name, e.g. `"aniread"`. See [Packages](../packages/index.qmd) for the full list.
:::

## [2]{.step-number} Load

Load the metapackage to bring the full workflow into scope:

```r
library(animovement)
```

## [3]{.step-number} Learn

You're ready to analyse movement. Work through an end-to-end example — reading a
tracking file, checking its quality, processing it, computing metrics and
plotting the result — in the tutorials:

[Browse the tutorials →](../learn/index.qmd){.btn .btn-primary}

::: {.callout-note}
Single-package how-tos live on each package's own reference site (see
[Packages](../packages/index.qmd)). The [Learn](../learn/index.qmd) section here is for
cross-package, end-to-end workflows.
:::
